title: Modern LaTeX Editions of Public-Domain Mathematics Manuscripts
description:
This record is the public front page for an ongoing open project to produce modern, inspectable LaTeX editions and translations of older mathematics and physics manuscripts. Public-domain scans and source witnesses are collected, transcribed into TeX, checked into readable PDFs, organized by author/work or coherent corpus, and published with source artifacts so readers can inspect, correct, fork, and continue the work.

Current project map.

  • Main corpus and bulk preservation record: [##########] 100/100 this landing record remains the broad cumulative surface, with reader PDFs, artifact ZIPs, manifests, and full-repository preservation material. Current main record: 10.5281/zenodo.20415117; earlier broad cumulative record: 10.5281/zenodo.20410262; concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20393488.
  • EGA working English translation and source package: [###-------] 30/100 toward complete translated/proofread EGA; [##########] French originals present EGA I-II are largely inherited from the community translation; current project additions include EGA 0_IV sections 15 through 23, EGA IV sections 1 through 18 as substantive working translations, short substantive material for EGA IV section 20, and stubs for EGA IV sections 19 and 21. The current English reader is an 850-page working PDF, with all eight NUMDAM French originals included separately as direct top-level PDFs and TeX/source packets in ZIP artifacts. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20424211.
  • SGA working English translation: [##########] 100/100 for the current SGA 4 working draft; SGA 5 is now active The current SGA record contains SGA 1-3 English/source snapshots, a 613-page complete current SGA 4 English working reader through Exposes I-XIX, separate SGA 4 expose-level reader PDFs, and a new SGA 5 reader with Expose I complete plus Expose III/III B material through III B section II.5.10. SGA 1-7 French reference PDFs are included for checking. Public reader PDFs are organized as coherent volume/expose readers with TeX/source/provenance material in ZIP artifacts. Final local checks before publication: all 35 staged PDFs opened under short-path pdfinfo/text checks, the top-level PDF text sweep found no internal process/tool labels, and all 14 ZIP artifacts passed integrity checks. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20425251.
  • Non-European and multilingual mathematical manuscripts: [#########-] 93/100 for the current multilingual working release; broader corpus expansion continues consolidated release for Chinese, Indian/Sanskrit, Islamic/Arabic, and historical-reference mathematical works, organized as 7 combined reader PDFs, 58 direct work-level PDFs, 6 source/provenance/audit ZIP artifacts, and a public JSON summary. The current public PDFs use clean title pages and human-readable filenames; 3 source-rendered components with visible upstream error-page artifacts are preserved in the ZIP archives but held out of top-level reader PDFs pending clean rerender. Final local checks before publication: 66 top-level PDFs passed short-path text screening with no internal process labels, all 6 ZIP artifacts passed integrity checks, and the audit packet records 158 source PDFs checked with 146 structurally recommended for possible public reader use. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20424994.
  • Chinese mathematical classics: [########--] 80/100 corpus page for Chinese mathematical works with language-separated readers and source artifacts; public reader PDFs use clean archive-style front matter. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20421647.
  • Indian and Sanskrit mathematical classics: [########--] 80/100 corpus page for Sanskrit/Indian mathematical works with language-separated readers and source artifacts; public reader PDFs use clean archive-style front matter. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20421650.
  • Islamic and Arabic mathematical texts: [########--] 80/100 corpus page for Arabic/Islamic mathematical works with original-language, translation, and source artifacts; public reader PDFs use clean archive-style front matter. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20421656.
  • Historical reference witnesses: [#######---] 70/100 corpus page for selected historical reference translations and witnesses used to compare terminology and context; public reader PDFs use clean archive-style front matter. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20421657.
  • Heinrich Weber: [######----] 60/100 author page with modern LaTeX drafts for Lehrbuch der Algebra Volumes I and III plus current English draft material from Volume II, including group theory, abelian groups, characters, reciprocal groups, Lagrange resolvents, linear substitutions, transposed substitutions, projective actions, binary substitutions, absolute invariants, form problems, Galois groups, metacyclic groups, abstract groups, alternating groups, orthogonal groups, and fractional linear groups. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20422935.
  • Emmy Noether: [#####-----] 50/100 author page with a selected mathematical-papers modern LaTeX draft, with collected-volume wrapper pages removed, and five current English translation drafts covering the 1910 invariant-theory note, the 1916 finite-groups invariant theorem, integral rational representation of invariants, and an absolute-irreducibility criterion. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20422936.
  • Deligne papers: [######----] 60/100 dedicated record for Deligne paper PDFs and working translation/source material, kept separate so it can be revised or removed independently if needed. Current clean record: 10.5281/zenodo.20414959.
  • Classical algebra and arithmetic manuscripts: [######----] 60/100 organized shelf for selected Cayley, Dedekind, Dirichlet, Gauss, Weber, and Noether modern LaTeX working drafts; 21 top-level reader PDFs passed structural/display checks, with the current Noether reader using the wrapper-removed selected mathematical-papers build. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20418609.
  • Additional author cluster: [######----] 60/100 cleaner reader PDFs and source/provenance artifacts for Minkowski, Hecke, Landau, Steinitz, Hensel, Oka, Hausdorff, Grassmann, Killing, and nearby material; duplicate/mislabelled surface material consolidated, and obvious modern collected-volume wrappers removed from the public PDFs. Current record: 10.5281/zenodo.20416839.

Workflow. Source scans and witnesses are indexed, converted into TeX drafts, reviewed into readable PDFs, and published with source artifacts for inspection and correction. Reader-facing files are organized by author, work, or coherent corpus; source archives and editorial work files are kept in artifact ZIPs rather than in public titles or reader PDFs.

File organization. Top-level PDFs are reader-facing files intended for browsing and direct download. ZIP files contain TeX/source material, source scans or witnesses where appropriate, OCR text, provenance, manifests, and audit outputs. Records are being split by author or coherent corpus while this main record remains the single landing page and bulk preservation surface.

Quality note. These are working scholarly drafts, not final critical editions. Technical PDF audits check whether files open and extract text; they do not prove mathematical correctness. Some drafts still need layout repair, source comparison, theorem-number checking, and human proofreading. Availability is preserved while cleaner organized versions are built.
notes: Front page for the modern LaTeX manuscript project. Current highlighted records include SGA 20425251, non-European multilingual manuscripts 20424994, EGA 20424211, Weber 20422935, Noether 20422936, and the broad cumulative landing/preservation surface.
